description.value: Otter Co-op is a locally-owned consumer co-operative serving communities across the Fraser Valley and beyond, including Abbotsford. The Abbotsford location operates under the Federated Co-operatives umbrella and offers food, fuel, pharmacy, and liquor services. A 'Highwayman' brand is also listed among its service categories, suggesting a possible dine-in or prepared-food offering.
